offering_description.value: Provides private-duty nursing, personal care and therapy for medically complex children and adults. It also provides home health and hospice care, primarily for older adults. Local care teams visit patients at home, and the company delivers tube-feeding supplies and equipment to patients and caregivers.

primary_products.value: enteral nutrition formulas; feeding pumps; feeding tubes and related supplies

primary_services.value: private-duty nursing; personal care; pediatric therapy; skilled home health; hospice care

customer_segment.value: B2C: Medically complex children and adults, older adults, hospice patients and their caregivers; B2B: Managed care organizations and commercial health insurers that pay for patient care and supplies; B2G: State Medicaid programs, Medicare and public school districts that contract for nursing or therapy

end_markets.value: pediatric home care; adult long-term home care; post-acute home health; hospice; home enteral nutrition

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicaid, Medicare and private insurers reimburse nursing, home health visits, hospice care and enteral supplies; project or contract: School districts pay for contracted nursing and therapy staffing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Deploys nurses, therapists and aides to deliver care to children and adults; distributor: Sources enteral formulas, pumps and supplies from manufacturers and delivers them to patients and caregivers

geography_served.value: US national: Multiple US regions, including the Northeast, Southeast, Midwest and West

specialization.value: related lines: Private-duty nursing and personal care, home health and hospice, and home enteral nutrition supplies

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Local branches coordinate intake and dispatch clinicians and aides to patients’ homes; other: Referrals from hospitals, discharge planners, physicians and health plan case managers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing for home care and hospice agencies, plus applicable Medicare certification and Medicaid participation requirements
